LISA – DREAM feat. Kentaro Sakaguchi (Official Short Film MV) has been released on YouTube!
Exciting news for fans of LISA! The highly anticipated official short film music video for “DREAM,” featuring Kentaro Sakaguchi, has just dropped on YouTube. This stunning visual masterpiece showcases LISA’s incredible artistry and the mesmerizing collaboration with the talented actor Kentaro Sakaguchi. You can watch the full video here and immerse yourself in the enchanting world crafted by this dynamic duo.
DREAM FILM OUT NOW
The “DREAM” film is more than just a music video; it’s a captivating narrative that highlights LISA’s versatility as an artist. The interplay between her powerful vocals and Sakaguchi’s compelling performance draws you into a dream-like atmosphere that resonates with themes of ambition and self-discovery. Fans of BLACKPINK and LISA will find themselves spellbound by the artistry and emotion that this film conveys.
Don’t miss out on the chance to experience this unique collaboration. LISA continues to break barriers in the music industry, and “DREAM” is a testament to her creative vision. Be sure to share your thoughts and reactions on social media using the tags #LISAxDREAM and @BLACKPINK.
Whether you’re a long-time supporter or new to LISA’s music, this film is a must-watch. Join the conversation and celebrate this remarkable release with fellow fans around the globe! Check it out and let the dream begin!
